messages:
Ivy Lopez: Quick heads-up — planning a config-only rollout tonight in the 21:30-22:30 UTC change window. Scope: routing bias to low-latency edge, enable request-coalescing, tighten idle timeout. No model or code changes.
deploy-bot: @Ivy Lopez: Change queued: cfg-2026-03-edge-coalesce. Start ETA 2026-03-21 21:30 UTC. Approvals: eng-releases auto.
Noah Becker: ACK. I can watch the canary. Checklist: canary 3%, alerts wired, rollback pin, release-note snippet.
Priya Singh: Please pin model v1.10.0 during the window and keep fallback v1.9.5 ready. Add p95/p99 + error-rate alarms.
Ivy Lopez: Config excerpt (applied):
```yaml
routing:
  edge_priority: 0.9
  fallback_priority: 0.1
coalescing:
  enabled: true
  max_coalesce_ms: 8
batching:
  tiny_batch_threshold: 4
  max_batch_tokens: 16384
timeouts:
  idle_ms: 35
  req_timeout_ms: 25000
```
Carlos Mendez: Tiny batch 4 seems aggressive for some tenant profiles (long-polling). Recommend tagging `tinybatch: opt-out` for streaming/async tenants.
Noah Becker: Canary started (3%). Traces flowing. Watching coalescing latency and request tail.
Priya Singh: Dash created: /dashboards/partitions/cfg-2026-03-edge-coalesce — alert rules: p95 > baseline+12ms, errors > 0.02% over 2m.
Ivy Lopez: Rolling to 10% after 5m if stable.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 10%. Logs: https://ci.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-03-edge-coalesce
Noah Becker: Early metrics: p95 stable, p99 +8ms on edge hosts, overall error rate 0.01%. Coalescing shows small reduction in token cost.
Carlos Mendez: Noted a small uptick in `stream-timeout` warnings from async-tenants on host pool e7. Might be due to tiny_batch_threshold.
Ivy Lopez: Pausing ramp. Reverting tiny_batch_threshold to 8 for pool e7 only. Pushing cohort patch now.
Priya Singh: Set adhesion: if stream-timeout warnings > 0.3% in 5m -> rollback tiny-batching for that pool. Alarm set.
Noah Becker: Patch applied to cohort e7. Canary remains at 10%.
Priya Singh: Perf traces show fallback path latency spike on region us-west-2 when requests route off-edge. p99 there +45ms. Setting emergency threshold: p99 > baseline+50ms triggers rollback.
Ivy Lopez: We won't roll back routing weight yet — holding while we address batch/coalesce.
deploy-bot: Alert triggered at 1734447980: stream-timeout warnings exceeded threshold on e7 cohort.
Noah Becker: Seeing the alert. Reverting coalescing `max_coalesce_ms` to 12ms and tiny_batch_threshold to 8 for e7. Applying now.
Carlos Mendez: After revert, stream-timeouts drop. CPU/mem healthy. No new errors.
Ivy Lopez: Resuming rollout with tiny_batch_threshold 8 for e7 and 4 elsewhere. Moving to 40% if stable for 10m.
Priya Singh: Also adding note: pin fallback v1.9.5 is ready, but we're not switching. If p99 > baseline+80ms we will execute `scripts/rollback_pin.sh cfg-2026-03-edge-coalesce v1.9.5`.
Noah Becker: 40% now. Observability: cost down ~0.7% but fallback p99 still occasionally +30ms in us-west-2 under burst.
Ivy Lopez: Decision: keep route weight change, keep idle_ms 35, defer global tiny-batching to a follow-up (RFC). We'll only enable coalescing with conservative settings and opt-out tag for streaming tenants.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 2026-03-21 22:25 UTC. Summary: routing bias + coalescing enabled (conservative), tiny-batching limited and opt-outs applied, idle timeout reduced. Partial cohort-specific reverts applied during canary.
Priya Singh: Final checks: dashboards green, no error spikes, p95 within SLO, cost change +0.9%. Logged follow-ups: RFC for staged tiny-batching, tenant opt-out list, long-term perf test for fallback path.
Noah Becker: Thx all. I added a short note to release-notes: "Config-only: edge routing preference, request coalescing enabled conservatively, idle timeout tightened; tiny-batching staged and restricted to non-streaming tenants." :white_check_mark:
Ivy Lopez: Great work. Closing window. Will follow up on RFCs tomorrow.
